fields.name: priority
fields.description: u8: 0x00 normal, 0x01 bulk, 0x02 background - sender hint for transport-level scheduling. Unknown bytes decode as normal.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: must be zero on encode, ignored on decode

fields.name: length
fields.description: u64 BE byte length of payload (post-compression)
